# Airwalk eBook — Creator Programme

> Airwalk (Timișoara, Romania) turns a content creator's knowledge into a finished digital guide (ebook): written in the creator's voice, fully designed for phone and print, put on sale on its own page with automatic payment and delivery, and launched with a ready-made social media kit. The creator pays nothing at any point. From agreement to launch day takes 3 weeks at most and about 3-4 hours of the creator's time, plus a few minutes a day in launch week. Earnings are split equally.

The site is available in Romanian (default) and English.

## Programme pages
- [Programul Airwalk pentru creatori (RO)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/): the full programme in Romanian — the 9 steps, what the creator gets, the launch kit, a case study and FAQ.
- [The Airwalk Creator Programme (EN)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/en/): the same programme in English.
- [Alătură-te (RO)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/alatura-te/) / [Join us (EN)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/en/join/): the entry criteria (15,000-300,000 followers, a recent video over 20,000 views, teaching content, no own paid product on the same topic) and the application form.

## Presentations (PDF)

- [The Airwalk Creator Programme (EN, PDF)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/program/en/Airwalk-Creator-Programme-EN.pdf)

## Case study: Aron Bob, The Complete Tesla Guide
- [Ghidul complet Tesla pentru România (RO sales page)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/aron-bob/ghid-tesla/): 37 pages in 10 chapters, Romanian edition.
- [The Complete Tesla Guide (EN sales page)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/aron-bob/tesla-guide/): English edition.

## Key facts
- How it works: discovery (a 30-minute call or a written questionnaire), the creator's existing materials, outline, content (a recorded 60-90 minute call or a written document), writing, design, sales page and payment, automatic delivery, then promotion: three kits (pre-launch, launch, after launch) and a new kit every month. The agreement is signed last, before launch.
- Every guide comes in a phone version and an A4 print version.
- Promotion is required (the creator chooses the source: our materials, theirs or both); we schedule posts through Meta partner access. If the launch is not promoted within 30 days, either side can end the agreement. A launch price runs for the first week; the creator gets a monthly report with improvements. Paid ads are optional, managed free of charge, budget split 50/50.
